repos.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI job application framework that runs locally to evaluate postings, tailor CVs, and prepare for interviews.
bullets: Built on Claude Code for local execution and privacy.
Automates the end-to-end job search pipeline including CV tailoring and cover letter generation.
Designed for personal ownership, allowing users to fork and customize their own job-hunting agent.
Provides structured evaluation of job postings to filter for high-probability matches.

repos.name: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server

Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.one_liner: A native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for x64dbg that enables AI agents to control the debugger via HTTP.
bullets: Written in Zig for high-performance, low-overhead integration with the debugger.
Exposes full x64dbg functionality to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
Enables agentic reverse engineering and automated vulnerability research workflows.
Bridges the gap between LLM reasoning and low-level binary analysis tools.

repos.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
repos.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and more.
repos.one_liner: A massive, curated repository of 1000+ agent skills compatible with major AI coding assistants.
bullets: Standardized skill library compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
Covers a wide range of operational tasks from infrastructure management to data processing.
Acts as a central knowledge base for developers building complex agentic workflows.
Facilitates modular agent development by providing plug-and-play functional components.

repos.name: Leonxlnx/unlazy
repos.description: Anti-laziness skill for AI agents. Core: the Depth Tree method, which splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model laziness, underthinking and premature completion.
repos.one_liner: An AI agent optimization framework using the 'Depth Tree' method to maximize task effort and output quality.
bullets: Implements the Depth Tree method to recursively split tasks into N layers.
Allocates full time budgets to leaf nodes to ensure deep, high-effort execution.
Designed to combat 'lazy' AI behavior by forcing granular, grounded reasoning.
Useful for complex coding or research tasks requiring sustained attention.

repos.name: ripienaar/free-for-dev
repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, community-maintained list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with free tiers for developers.
bullets: Essential infrastructure resource for bootstrapping fintech and startup projects.
Categorized by service type including cloud hosting, databases, and monitoring tools.
Helps developers minimize operational costs during the early stages of product development.
Regularly updated to reflect current market offerings and tier changes.
